(async()=>{const G=(await import('/js/flight/gtiles.js')).GT, E=await import('/js/core/engine.js'), THREE=await import('three'); const r=new THREE.Raycaster(); const out=[]; for (const [x,y] of [[-0.7,-0.5],[-0.4,-0.2],[0.5,-0.5]]) { r.setFromCamera(new THREE.Vector2(x,y), E.camera); const h=r.intersectObject(G.holder,true)[0]; if(!h){out.push(null); continue;} let tile=null; G.tiles.traverse(t=>{ if(tile) return true; const sc=t.cached&&t.cached.scene; if(sc){ let has=false; sc.traverse(o=>{if(o===h.object) has=true}); if(has) tile=t; } return false; }); out.push({p:h.point.toArray().map(v=>+v.toFixed(0)), ge: tile&&+tile.geometricError.toFixed(0), d: tile&&+(tile.__distanceFromCamera||0).toFixed(0)}); } return JSON.stringify(out)})()
